preconditions.description: The number of rows n must be between 1 and 10.
The number of columns m must be between 1 and 10.
The number of levels k must be between 1 and 1000.
The constant w must be between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(len(level) == n * m for level in levels)
preconditions.description: Each level must have exactly n * m characters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in ".abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ" for level in levels for c in level)
preconditions.description: Each character in the levels must be either a dot or a letter of the English alphabet.

postconditions.description: The output must start with the minimum number of transferred bytes.
The number of transfer pairs must equal the number of levels k.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= k and (y == 0 or 1 <= y <= k) for x, y in transfers)
postconditions.description: Each transfer pair must contain valid level indices.
